description: This file defines a React functional component named `FilterComponent` used for rendering and managing filter UI within a dashboard or data table. It includes interface definitions for filter options and values, state management for filter states and asynchronous searches, and UI rendering logic for searchable and selectable filters with reset and toggle functionality.

methods.name: FilterComponent
methods.description: Main React functional component that renders filter UI, manages filter state, performs asynchronous searches for searchable filters, and handles user interactions like applying and resetting filters.
